tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ After `off-by-one seed` on a fresh DB, select count(*) from problem_edges > 0 AND GET /api/v1/problems/<seeded-class>/related returns a non-empty related[] whose entries carry problem_class, relationship and weight, with tests in internal/graph and internal/seed proving the seed path creates the edges; go build/vet/test all green.: Producer wired: internal/graph/linker.go (new) LinkSimilarClasses/LinkAllSimilar writes `similar` edges both directions via Store.CreateEdge; internal/graph/store.go adds EdgeSimilar="similar" and accepts it in the CreateEdge switch; internal/seed/seed.go calls store.LinkAllSimilar(ctx,2,5) after the file loop and records Stats.EdgesCreated; cmd/off-by-one/seed.go logs edges=%d created. Tests in both required packages: internal/graph/linker_test.go TestLinkSimilarClassesCreatesEdges/RespectsMinShared/RejectsZeroID/TestTitleTokens and internal/seed/seed_test.go TestSeedCreatesRelatedEdges (asserts stats.EdgesCreated>0, `SELECT count(*) FROM problem_edges`>0, ListEdgesFrom(class) non-empty with relationship=similar and 0<weight<=1, re-run EdgesCreated==0 and row count unchanged) — all PASS. Command evidence: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `gofmt -l cmd internal pkg sql` empty (exit 0); `go test ./internal/graph/... ./internal/seed/... -count=1 -p 1` -> `ok .../internal/graph 1.157s`, `ok .../internal/seed 4.154s`, exit 0; `go test ./... -short -count=1 -p 1 -timeout 600s` -> 13 packages ok, EXIT=0. Live end-to-end on fresh DB: `off-by-one seed -dir ./data -db /tmp/oby067/scratch.db` -> "seed complete: files=1793; classes=1793 created / 0 existing; answers=1880 created / 0 skipped; edges=7004 created", SEED_EXIT=0; `sqlite3 ... select count(*) from problem_edges` -> 7004 (>0); GET http://127.0.0.1:8791/api/v1/problems/python-sdk-idle-audit/related -> {"related":[{"problem_class":"h3-sdk-python-idle-audit-tick","relationship":"similar","weight":1},{"problem_class":"idle-audit-python-sdk","relationship":"similar","weight":1},{"problem_class":"python-idle-audit","relationship":"similar","weight":1},{"problem_class":"go-idle-audit","relationship":"similar","weight":1},{"problem_class":"python-sdk-duckdb-board-audit","relationship":"similar","weight":0.75},{"problem_class":"h3-sdk-idle-audit-tick","relationship":"similar","weight":0.75}]} — non-empty with all three fields; POST /api/v1/problems/discover with include_related:true also returns non-empty related[] carrying problem_class/relationship/weight (handler internal/api/handlers.go:577-611, relatedEntry struct lines 64-68).
The seed path now produces 7004 real `similar` problem_edges on a fresh DB and both /related and discover.related return non-empty entries with problem_class/relationship/weight, backed by passing tests in internal/graph and internal/seed and green build/vet/test.
